## Meta Platforms, Inc. (META) `Internet & Platforms`
- CEO Mark Zuckerberg introduced Meta’s $1,299 Meta VR Glasses and the Muse Charm handheld device at the company’s Connect developer conference on Wednesday, September 23, 2026; the Muse Charm is designed to work with Meta’s Muse AI agent and is expected to go on sale by December 2026. (CNBC)
- Meta shares rose after the product announcements and reports of optimism around the Muse AI agent; the company’s Thursday move followed a gain of approximately 12% earlier in the week. (CNBC)
- The S&P 500 Communication Services sector rose 1.5% on Thursday, with Meta, Verizon, and Walt Disney among the sector’s advancing stocks. (Investopedia)

## Everpure, Inc. (P) `AI Infrastructure`
- Everpure reported fiscal 2027 revenue guidance of $5.03 billion to $5.07 billion and non-GAAP operating-income guidance of $940 million to $960 million. (Everpure company release)
- Everpure issued preliminary fiscal 2028 revenue guidance of $7.0 billion to $7.3 billion and non-GAAP operating-income guidance of $1.7 billion to $1.9 billion. (Everpure company release)
- The preliminary fiscal 2028 revenue range exceeded the $6.19 billion average analyst estimate cited by FactSet. (CNBC)
- Everpure’s shares advanced after the company’s financial analyst meeting and the release of its fiscal 2028 outlook. (CNBC)

## Nebius Group N.V. (NBIS) `AI Infrastructure`
- Bank of America raised its 2026, 2027, and 2028 revenue expectations for Nebius, reiterated a Buy rating, and maintained a $310 price target in a Thursday, September 24, 2026 report. (CNBC)
- Bank of America analyst Tal Liani said Nebius uses long-duration hyperscaler contracts as a utilization base and reserves capacity for one- to three-year contracts priced at approximately twice hyperscaler rates. (CNBC)
- Nebius announced planned October 1, 2026 price increases of approximately 17% for H100 capacity, 20% for H200, 19% for B200, and 21% for B300 capacity. (24/7 Wall St.)
- The October 1 pricing changes were described as Nebius’s second announced price increase in three months. (24/7 Wall St.)
